title: Fallbacks for CSS `progress()`
partialText: The new CSS progress() function calculates a value between 0 and 1, representing its position within a defined range. While awaiting broader browser support, users can manually implement this using other methods.

title: You Don’t Know Bidi (And Neither Does ChatGPT)
partialText: Text that is set in a left-to-right *and* right-to-left language, mid-sentence, is a thing. Getting it right means understanding it, because your LLM isn't going to know.
